historicalLinuxGraphDiagnostic.interpretation: The preceding pre-LF v2 archive ran six graph/archive cases: five passed and a strict duplicate-import assertion failed when temporary files reappeared after cleanup in the managed Linux filesystem. Installed bytes were unchanged. This failure is retained, not relabelled. Both exact-final native Windows graph suites now pass all six cases including duplicate-import immutability.

historicalFailedNativeCandidate.interpretation: All four real IQ-TREE runs completed in each path, but exact multiline JSON assertions failed because Windows text output used CRLF. Subsequent graph/scientific steps were skipped. The final adapter writes explicit LF and the regression reads raw bytes like the released checker; scientific assertions and algorithms were preserved. Exact-final validation now passes.

pack.name: IQ-TREE phylogenetic inference
pack.description: Local nucleotide/protein maximum-likelihood trees, model selection and optional branch support. Workbench 0.6.0 or newer.

sourceClosureEvidence.file: evidence/current/dependency-source-audit.json in source/evidence companion; licenses/dependency-source-audit.json in installable pack

upstreamBuildEvidence.file: licenses/upstream-dependency-evidence.txt in installable pack; evidence/current/upstream-dependency-evidence.txt in source companion
upstreamBuildEvidence.interpretation: Official IQ-TREE Windows executable and Intel OpenMP DLL are unchanged. Corresponding IQ-TREE/submodule, Boost, Eigen, Cargo crate, phylo_grad, Rust standard-library and CPython sources plus notices are retained under installable licenses/. Packaging does not claim a bitwise reproduction of the upstream compiler environment.

scientificScope: Explicit nucleotide and protein aligned-FASTA operations use unchanged upstream IQ-TREE3.1.4 for maximum-likelihood inference. Default ModelFinder selects by BIC; bounded fixed-model alternatives are exposed.
Optional genuine ultrafast bootstrap and SH-aLRT use 1000-10000 replicates; ultrafast bootstrap uses -bnni. Defaults are two threads and seed42.

Independent synthetic known pair topology, model and site counts, actual support values, same-platform direct upstream agreement, safe original names, input/pack immutability and malformed-input/option guards are tested.
Actual published MUSCLE0.5.2 Super5 runs feed both DNA and protein inference. Tests preserve residues, derive site counts from the real aligned output and independently verify the known topology.

Newick trees retain every leaf and are unrooted with an arbitrary display root. Detailed JSON bipartition summaries are explicitly omitted above256 taxa to avoid quadratic output; complete Newick remains unchanged.
boundaries: Native installation checks use the released Workbench bridge/importer and scientific runner. Graph/archive tests use a copy-based publication callback; they do not themselves execute scientific programs or the native importer. Installed-PE scientific regressions are separate.
Research/teaching synthetic validation; no clinical, diagnostic, regulatory or institutional approval claim. No large-phylogeny performance benchmark or interactive GUI acceptance test.

Windows installation/results paths must be ASCII; ordinary and space-containing paths are tested. Unicode input is staged successfully, and Unicode output fails before writes. Long paths, interactive cancellation and network firewall behavior are not validated.

Frontend accepts uncompressed aligned FASTA within documented size, taxon and column bounds, requires four distinct sequences and at least one parsimony-informative column, and rejects unsupported protein stop/U/O/J symbols. These are explicit pack constraints, not universal IQ-TREE limitations.
Nucleotide U is normalized to T, dots to gaps and letters to uppercase; original taxon identifiers are restored safely and provenance records transformations and exact commands.

No promise of bitwise floating-point equality across operating systems, CPU models, thread counts or builds. Full source dependencies and pins are retained; upstream official binaries are used without scientific patches.
Publisher identity is not authenticated by offline inventory/SHA verification. Signed-catalogue trust deployment is separate from this evidence.
